FIELDS.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Boutique
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Paws & Claws Pet Boutique, our core operations focus on providing high-quality pet products and professional grooming services for common domestic animals, including dogs, cats, and small mammals. Our retail space features a carefully curated selection of pet supplies, food, toys, and accessories designed to meet the needs of pet owners. We ensure all staff have completed documented training in animal handling, grooming, and safety protocols, creating a safe environment for both pets and customers. In our grooming salon, we maintain strict adherence to health and safety standards, including secure animal enclosures and non-slip flooring throughout the facility. We operate with a clean claims history, reflecting our commitment to effective risk management and high standards of animal welfare. Our grooming services are offered by appointment to ensure individualized attention, while our experienced team monitors the health and comfort of each pet throughout their visit.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities involving aggressive or exotic animals and confirms that we have been continuously operating for over three years. Furthermore, all staff members possess documented training in animal handling, grooming, and safety protocols, and our facilities are equipped with secure animal enclosures, non-slip flooring, and fire prevention systems.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/10/2023, a water leak from a broken pipe in the storage area caused damage to inventory and equipment, resulting in a loss of $1,000. The claim is currently in progress.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel Safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing with 24/7 monitored security camera system and on-site watchperson during operating hours.
